name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any public website for the root causes of poor AI discoverability (not found, not cited, misrepresented by AI assistants) and poor on-site engagement, then emits one structured report of evidence-backed findings with prioritized, platform-specific fixes.

skills.role: Owns the audit run end to end: resolves the target, crawls once into a shared cache, profiles the site, invokes every detector against that cache, merges and de-duplicates findings, scores each gate, and emits the single audit report.

Gate 1 - Access. Can a machine reach the content at all? robots.txt and AI-crawler directives, WAF/bot user-agent gating, noindex, status codes, redirects, canonicals, TLS, host duplication, sitemap health.

Gate 2 - Render. Can a machine read what a human sees? JavaScript render gap, SPA shells, hydration-only content, facts locked in images and PDFs, interaction-gated content, semantic document structure.
Gate 3a - Extract (machine-readable facts). JSON-LD/microdata parse validity, schema.org type coverage gated by page type, and per-type required-field completeness.

Gate 3b - Extract (quotable prose). Whether a retrieval-augmented assistant can lift one clear, self-contained sentence that answers a real user question: identity statements, atomic facts, question-shaped headings, query-surface coverage.

Gate 4 - Trust. Whether an extracted fact will be believed and repeated: self-consistent brand description, entity disambiguation, sameAs identity graph, corroboration surface, freshness signals, and off-site verification that the profiles the site declares as its own actually resolve and point back.

On-site engagement. Why a visitor who does arrive - usually deep-linked from an assistant, with no prior context - fails to orient, act, or stay: orientation, standalone page context, CTA clarity, friction and interstitials, weight and mobile readiness, dead ends, accessibility blockers.

Turns detector findings into fixes in the site's actual stack. Fingerprints the CMS/framework and rewrites each suggested action into platform-specific steps, then adds proactive recommendations that go beyond the detected defects.

safety.network: outbound HTTP(S) GET/HEAD to the audited site, plus the external profiles that site declares as its own in sameAs (at most 8 per audit, each host's robots.txt honoured; disable with --no-offsite)

optional: playwright (upgrades the JavaScript render-gap check from heuristic to measured)
